deferrals.reason: On Theseus PRs #5 and #16, test (windows, py3.12) failed test_concurrent_cold_installs_of_one_key_all_succeed_and_leave_a_valid_install, then passed on rerun. The test covers the msvcrt install-key lock in bootstrap.py, which BenchBox vendors as _project/scripts/theseus_bootstrap.py. It has not been investigated: this may be a real race on Windows, not just test timing.
deferrals.summary: Investigate Windows flake: concurrent cold installs of one key (test_bootstrap.py) may be a real race in the vendored bootstrap lock

deferrals.reason: At v0.1.6 (6e5765e), the empty-secret refusal step tells callers to pass secrets: inherit. inherit does not cross owners, so the message misleads. Since v0.1.6 declares required secrets, the step now fires only when the caller's environment lacks a secret. Fix it in the next Theseus release.
deferrals.summary: Theseus gate.yml/review.yml App-secret refusal message still says callers must pass secrets: inherit; should say map by name

description: Promoted from deferral 1 on theseus-atomic-benchbox-cutover-20261102: The cutover head 4cbb820 received a hosted SHIP. A local review then found a Medium: the Theseus gate posts no status when the trusted policy or a manifest fails to load. That is fail-open only if develop's own policy is broken. Merging now and fixing in one small re-lock PR beats restarting a 1–2 h review cycle. The local review also rejects the canonical lowercase slug against the origin URL case; check whether Theseus has the same case-sensitivity bug.
